lines.text: Endmin, you're here.
We're still documenting the damages suffered by this place... Even the Yinglungs hardly ever reached this place.
Nothing too dangerous. It's the pillars over there.
Yinglung surveillance missions usually target locations near Tanjian Hall... But just look at these Yinglung Pillars. So many of them...
Yeah ... and I got curious about the people who planted them here. This is way beyond the usual range of Yinglung surveillance...
We'll be keeping the Yinglung Pillars here for a while, just in case. Some of us did find a damaged pillar, though.
I wonder if you can salvage and analyze it, Endmin. We might learn more about this place...
I don't want any heroic deed to fade into obscurity.
Great. I'll send you the location. The new aero-salvager module should be able to retrieve it.
Really?! You acted way in advance, Endmin. Saved us a ton of trouble.
The chips...
Stern ... Shore... They were team leaders who took part in that major surveillance operation two years ago.
They were the ones who did all this...
They did... Wuling must remember them. History should note their names down.
As for Shore... Endmin, I have to share what we found with Phrase. It's something she really cares about.
Wuling will remember them for ages to come.
Already?! Terrific news. That saved us a great deal of trouble.
The location... Yeah. It's the trail of Yinglung Pillars we saw along the way! The damaged pillar happens to be the last one on record...
That means the person who planted these Yinglung Pillars ... came to a stop not too far from here...
Hmm... Endmin, they might have left something nearby.
We've analyzed the sites nearby. I'll sync you the areas that haven't been searched yet.
These data... They were the ones who planted the pillars...
Endmin, that pillar... It might contain some information we should study.
Got it. We can use these pillars to map out the route they took.
That's right! Please help us salvage the Yinglung Pillar! I'm counting on you, Endmin!
Those who planted these pillars may have left their War Case nearby. Find the War Case so that we can reveal their identities.
Salvaging a War Case shouldn't be difficult ... but Yinglung Pillars are huge. A standard aero-salvager probably can't lift it up.
Remember the new module I mentioned?
Of course I do. I'll salvage both the War Case, and the Yinglung Pillar.

options: What strange thing were you talking about?
The pillars got us safely here.
I also want to know who did all this.
I salvaged from these coordinates. Found a War Case too.
Looks familiar. I think I've salvaged that damaged Yinglung Pillar.
I didn't find the Yinglung Pillar, but I picked up a War Case.
They chose to brave the Miasma...
